description: Shows the person the storyboard as a card to approve (a timeline on the recorded take, each beat with its time, words, on-screen plan and a sketch in the film's colours; once a plan is saved with save_animatic, a real rough frame of each beat, drawn from the plan before any film code exists) and keeps it in their studio. It is a stop only when they asked to see the storyboard: then call it with every version you propose, before asking for approval, and build only after they approve ("I approve the storyboard"). Otherwise save it through fuzzframe_action, so no card waits for them, and go on.

beats.description: The beats in order, each on a paragraph of the voiceover

hero.description: What the film's hero object does in this beat, or empty

label.description: The beat's name in two or three words ("Hook", "How it works", "Ending")

motion.description: What moves in this beat and how

onScreen.description: What the viewer sees; put the words that appear on screen in quotes

concept.description: The idea of the film in two or three sentences

ending.description: How the film ends on screen

fonts.description: The film's two fonts: display for headlines, body for the rest

hero.description: The one object that carries through the film, or empty

use.description: What it is used for: ground, ink, accent…

name: save_storyboard
title: Show and save the storyboard
